methods.truncation: Compare response status and candidate-token usage for the three frozen 4096-token baseline repetitions with one preregistered 8192-token probe call per page.
methods.geometry: Replay byte-verified baseline responses. Report pairwise box F1 and target recall under coverage v2. Separately compute reading-order sequence CER after symmetric anchor/apostrophe normalization and exclusion of Latin-dominant unannotated lines, so text stability is not made dependent on IoU identity.
methods.causal_limit: The probe distinguishes observed mechanisms but does not claim access to hidden model internals or estimate population failure rates.
